subject: CarePlex: implementation vs recurring structure + evidence & delivery milestones
messages:
From: Emma Stevens <emma.stevens@careplex.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Rajiv Patel <r.patel@careplex.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Pricing structure options for security pack (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency / HIPAA)

Camila —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We need to formalize pricing options for the security add-ons (audit log retention tiers, KMS with HSM seats, and US-only data residency + HIPAA attestation). Procurement is trying to decide between two models: pay an implementation/setup fee (one-time) + lower recurring add-on, or roll that cost into a higher recurring add-on with no upfront.

Specific asks from our side:
- Example line-item pricing for both approaches (numbers by line) so procurement can run through our TCO model.
- If you offer amortization of the implementation fee, what windows do you support (12/24 months) and how do credits show on invoices?
- Can you provide a milestone/evidence delivery plan (SOC2, KMS attestation, on-prem handshake) tied to payments?
- Our procurement prefers net60; will Redwood accept that on a PO for this deal?

Please loop in finance/legal if needed. Can we schedule a short call early next week to go through options?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Stevens
Sr. Procurement Manager, CarePlex Health
emma.stevens@careplex.com
+1 612-555-0198
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stevens <emma.stevens@careplex.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <r.patel@careplex.com>; ben_carter@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing structure options for security pack (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency / HIPAA)

Emma — great to connect! Thanks for the clear list. I captured this as two pragmatic commercial paths and a couple of optional concessions we can offer. High level (ballpark numbers to start conversation):

Option 1 — Upfront implementation + lower recurring
- Implementation & onboarding (one-time): $48,000 (SOW + evidence delivery orchestration)
- Monthly security add-on: $6,500/month (includes audit log retention 1yr, KMS management & 1 HSM seat)
- HSM additional seats: $3,000/seat/month

Option 2 — No upfront, blended recurring
- Monthly security add-on: $11,000/month (covers setup amortized across first 12 months, audit logs 1yr, KMS & 1 HSM seat)
- HSM additional seats unchanged

Concessions we can offer:
- Amortize the implementation fee over 12 or 24 months on invoices (we can show as a monthly line item credit).
- 20% one-time implementation discount if you sign a 12-month committed term for the security add-on.
- If you prepay annual, we can increase the discount to 25% and move to net30 payment terms.

Evidence & milestones (proposal):
1) SOW signed — 10% of implementation due
2) Test/Pilot execution (PoC) — 40% due once PoC validates logging and KMS access flows
3) Production cutover — 30% due
4) Final evidence package delivered (SOC2 excerpts, HSM attestation summary, audit log retention proof) — 20% due

I attached our SOC2 snapshot and a draft SOW for your team to review. (Attachments: SOC2-SR-Redwood-2025.pdf, SOW-draft-CarePlex.docx)

Next steps: I recommend a 30-minute call with Ben Carter (finance) to align on PO/net terms and Laura Bennett (legal) for contracting cadence. Are you available Wed 7/8 at 10am ET?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com; tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing structure options for security pack (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency / HIPAA)

Camila / team —

Quick finance view to support the call. We can be flexible, here are a couple of playbooks that work operationally:

A) Setup fee + amortization option (recommended for smaller month-to-month spenders)
- Allow amortization of the $48k over 12 or 24 months on the invoice as a negative line item (we've done 12/24 on prior deals).
- If customer signs 12-month commit on the security add-on, apply a one-time 20% concession on setup.

B) Blended recurring (recommended for customers who prefer OpEx simplicity)
- Keep no upfront, higher monthly; offer 10% discount if customer prepays annual. Payment terms move to net30 for prepay.

HSM commercial note: we generally treat HSM as a per-seat licensed add-on. If CarePlex prefers, we can convert to a pass-through monthly charge (vendor-managed) and clearly mark it on the invoice to avoid seat licensing friction.

To size discounts we need expected throughput/usage. Please ask CarePlex for approximate: average daily tokens, expected peak qps, and expected number of endpoints hitting the residency configuration — that drives egress/storage and audit log volume.

I'll join Wed 7/8 10am ET.
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance — Sales & GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Stevens <emma.stevens@careplex.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Rajiv Patel <r.patel@careplex.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing structure options for security pack (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency / HIPAA)

Camila / Ben —

Thanks for the clarity. CarePlex prefers an amortized setup line item over 12 months (option A with 12mo amortization) but would like the milestone schedule tightened so procurement can align payments with internal approval gates. Our proposed payment milestones:
- 15% at SOW signature (legal/PO stage)
- 35% after successful PoC (two-week pilot validating audit log integrity and KMS key rotation)
- 30% at production cutover
- 20% on delivery of evidence package (SOC2 excerpts + HSM attestation summary)

We can commit to a 12-month term on the security add-on if Redwood provides the 20% setup concession and agrees to invoice net60 on the PO. If Redwood requires net30 for discounted prepay, we are open to discuss but prefer net60.

Also: can you confirm how long Redwood takes to complete the KMS compliance questionnaire? We’ll need that for our security review next week.

Emma
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stevens <emma.stevens@careplex.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com; tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing structure options for security pack (audit logs / KMS/HSM / residency / HIPAA)

Emma — appreciate the counter-proposal; that payment milestone split works for us. Confirmations and next steps: 

- We will deliver an updated SOW reflecting 12-month amortization and the milestone schedule you proposed. Sending SOW v2 as an attachment (CarePlex-SOW-v2.docx).
- Finance confirms 20% one-time setup concession for a 12-month committed security add-on term. We will accept net60 on the PO for this deal (Finance flagged the credit risk but approved for strategic accounts).
- Legal will route DocuSign; I’ll share the envelope link once the SOW is finalized. (DocuSign envelope reference: EnvelopeId-12345)
- KMS questionnaire: our security team can complete the standard customer KMS questionnaire within 3 business days once you return the SCQ doc. We’ll also provide the HSM attestation summary and a SOC2 excerpt with the evidence package.

I’ve attached the updated SOW and will prep a short one-pager that maps the milestone payments to deliverables for your procurement folder. Call confirmed Wed 7/8 10am ET — invite sent.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: CarePlex-SOW-v2.docx; DocuSign-CarePlex-EnvelopeId-12345
